> Eod · Pipeliners · 2026-07-21

Tuesday. Pipeliners-only session: monsoon pillar refresh (August update).

# Pipeliners
See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Published the refresh in place at /monsoon-season-pipe-problems/ after a full backup.
- Added 2 H2 sections (how a plumber diagnoses a monsoon sewer problem, long-term repair options), expanded Key Takeaways to 6 bullets and FAQs to 7.
- Replaced 2 generic homepage links with 8 real internal destinations (hydro jetting, trenchless drain pipe repair, what is CIPP, cracked vs collapsed, Mesa camera inspection guide, tree roots, Chandler, contact).
- Kept the July 6 published date, slug, H1 and featured image; only the modified date changed.
- Pre-publish checks: 0 em dashes, 149-character meta, no pricing, free-quote or warranty language, all links live.
- Added FAQPage JSON-LD with all 7 visible questions (the pillar was missing it, unlike its 4 supporting posts).
- Focus keyphrase: "why does my sewer back up when it rains".

# Follow-ups
- Optional GSC re-index request for the pillar.
- Scott to decide on pricing, free-quote or warranty language.
- Decide named author vs "Pipeliners" byline (E-E-A-T).
- Next: September "post-monsoon inspections" cluster.
